p.t: A Student Project: A Peer-Reading Programme
x: Dao noticed that limited reading habits was becoming a problem. Instead of waiting for adults to solve it, the class designed a peer-reading programme at the language room.

Students collected information for four weeks before and after the change. Their report showed that weekly reading rose by 42 percent. The team said clear instructions and regular reminders were more useful than punishment.
